title: Rotoscoping — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Trace pass
scenes.purpose: Show the rotoscope workflow: an ink contour is traced over a soft reference plate on a light table.
visuals: Cool light-table cel with peg bar and registration marks
4px ink contour drawing around the figure
Fill A and Shade B hatching flood in

beats.development: Contour traces around the plate's first frame (0–0.55 s); Fill A and Shade B fill in (0.45–0.65 s). Headline and caption are static and readable throughout.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM
TRACE 0142 / 0240 · LINE 4PX · FILL A · SHADE B

scenes.title: Traced reach
scenes.purpose: The traced figure performs a weighted reach: settle, anticipation lean-back, reach with slight overshoot, settle. Drawings are held on twos.
visuals: Plate moves continuously; each traced drawing holds for 2 frames
Arm rises from the side to full extension; torso leans back, then forward

beats.development: Anticipation and reach: the arm draws in, then extends toward the network area.
Hand reaches the contact point; a Fill A touch ring opens at the fingertip while the pose settles.

scenes.title: Connected system
scenes.purpose: The contact point becomes the first vertex of a growing node network, and the reference plate is lifted away.
visuals: Edges draw outward from the hand
Four nodes pop in as their edges arrive
Plate fades out, leaving the traced cel

beats.development: Edges hand→upper node and hand→lower node, then to the right node, then the outer node; each node appears when its edge arrives. Plate fades out 1.55–2.05 s.
Settled hold on the full composition: figure, network, headline and caption.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

findings: Headline is static from frame 0, so it is readable for the full 3 s alongside the figure motion.
The reach takes 0.9 s with anticipation and settle so it reads as weighted, not mechanical.
Network nodes are staggered by about 0.1–0.25 s so the eye moves from the hand outward.
All motion ends by 2.6 s, inside the 2.7 s settle requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.6–3.0 s final hold lets the viewer read the completed system and the headline together.

notes: The motion is reconstructed from a hand-keyed joint track; no live-action footage was traced (none supplied).
Renderer: Canvas 2D plus SVG/HTML. Motion owner: GSAP. Pipeline: HyperFrames. Blender was not used.
